finding: Alterations in the infant gut microbiota, particularly enrichments of Clostridium sensu stricto 1 and Finegoldia, precede the development of eczema in a prospective Chinese cohort.
mod_finding: The study found that infants born by cesarean section had different gut microbiota composition compared to those born vaginally, and this difference was associated with an increased risk of developing eczema.
